answer: Payment follows a blind replication, not an identity. Each submission ships a recipe - inputs, arithmetic, one stated number - sealed from its replicator. The pool assigns it to an unpaired auditor: a stranger with forty clean epochs and a 150 POA bond. It recomputes the number at its own cost; a match splits the reward, a mismatch pays the auditor double from the author share. Two recipes per auditor per epoch. A thousand copies need five hundred seasoned strangers before one coin moves. Honest work stays an oasis; ivory towers of clones starve in the same ocean of auditors they cannot buy.
